chunks: If you are in doubt of what We have revealed to Our votary, then bring a Surah like this, and call any witness, apart from God, you like, if you are truthful.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Quran's challenge to produce a similar Surah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a challenge to the Arabs' specific linguistic prowess, highlighting that the Quran's miracle transcends mere eloquence to include spiritual and legislative depth. The mention of 'witnesses' (shuhada') is seen by scholars as an invitation to consult their own idols or false deities, underscoring the collective failure of polytheism to produce anything comparable. This inimitability (I'jaz) serves as a perpetual proof of prophethood, affirming the Quran as a living miracle for all generations.
